notes.title: News Update
notes.content:
A few months ago we told you that we have new stuff in the pipeline, this is still true! 
We are progressing very well, it is just taking it's time because we are completely changing the maps, adding effects and making a lot of tweaks in the gameplay. It will be a Version 2.0 \m/

Also we are adding a Story told in pictures ect.
This is taking some time but we want to give you a great free update so please be patient with us :-*

Cheers Nico

----> original News:
"Hey Guys,

I've seen all reviews so far and watched every Gamingvideo I found.
Thanks for taking the time to test the game :)
Right now we are working on several Things to make the Game-Experience better.

Here are the Points:
1. Rebuilding the Game in another Engine
2. Make Spell Animations more Fluid (more Frames)
3. get rid of Framerate problems while casting a spell first time on a map
4. Random Freezes when changing the character or using the retry button
5. Change the Leveldesign
6. Adding Controller Support
7. Adding a Tutorial
8. Fullscreen Mode
9. Sound Options
10. New Stages, New Enemies

I hope we can make these changes this year, I'll keep you up to date.
If there is anything else please let me know.

Cheers,
Nico"
